dek: Set for 22 August 2026 at Clark Parade Grounds, this SMOKE10 Events charity run combines road racing with a cause.
verdict: The Final Trace: A Strong Race for a Cause is a SMOKE10 Events charity road race at Clark Parade Grounds — one of the Philippines' best running venues with wide, flat, traffic-free roads. The charity framing gives the race community purpose. SMOKE10's Clark-based race production experience ensures a competent race-day operation. August in Pampanga is the wet season — warm and humid. For runners wanting a Clark race with charitable purpose, this is a meaningful pick.
